name: Union Buildings
subtitle: The seat of South Africa's government on Meintjieskop, overlooking Pretoria, designed by Herbert Baker and completed in 1913.

facts.label: Site choice
facts.value: Baker rejected the Market Street blocks as unworthy of the capital of united South Africa

facts.label: 1956 women's march
facts.value: About 20,000 women marched to the Union Buildings against apartheid pass laws

facts.label: Gardens
facts.value: Terraced grounds planted with indigenous plants

parts.text: The seat of South Africa's government on Meintjieskop, overlooking Pretoria, designed by Herbert Baker and completed in 1913. It houses the offices of the President and the terraced gardens hold events including Nelson Mandela's 1994 inauguration.
